item.title: Choosing the Right C++ Standard Template Library (STL) Container: A Decision Framework
item.description:
“Choosing the Right C++ Standard Template Library (STL) Container: A Decision Framework”

Framework for Selecting C++ STL Containers

Several expert opinions and visual aids converge on a principle: default to simplicity unless a clear performance bottleneck dictates otherwise. $\text{std::vector}$ frequently emerges as the primary recommendation.

Default Strategy and Contiguous Memory Needs

A strong foundational piece of advice suggests prioritizing $\text{std::vector}$ for nearly all scenarios unless a specific constraint pushes you toward another option.
